name: e-invoicing-tr-response-codes
title: UBL-TR application response codes (e-Fatura)
description: The ResponseCode values used on Turkish application and system responses (ApplicationResponse), with descriptions from Kod Listeleri §1.7 where available and usage hints from the UBL-TR schematron.

sources.title: UBL-TR Kod Listeleri, Versiyon 1.43, Temmuz 2026 (section 1.7 ResponseCode), in UBLTR_1.2.1_Kilavuzlar.zip, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16
e-Fatura Paketi, schematron/UBL-TR_Codelist.xml (ResponseCodeType) and sample XML comment for S_APR; package history up to 2026-07-01, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16

fields.name: name
fields.description: Description from the guide or from GİB sample material. Empty when neither names the code (GUMRUKONAY).

fields.name: in_schematron
fields.description: true when ResponseCodeType accepts the code.

fields.name: usage
fields.description: application for commercial/application responses; system for S_APR system responses.
